thresholdNote: A MAJORITY OF EIGHT IS FIVE. Four decides nothing, because the other side can reach four too. A cancelled half-suit belongs to nobody.
hiddenNote: EVEN A TEAMMATE'S HAND IS HIDDEN. Working out where the cards are is the game.
askRules: You may ask AN OPPONENT ONLY, for a half-suit you already hold, and only for a card you do NOT hold.
claimRules: You place all six cards. MISNAMING A TEAMMATE CANCELS the half-suit — it goes to nobody. If an opponent holds even one, they take it.
claimCancelledLine: {{name}} was CANCELLED (the placement was wrong; it does NOT go to the opponents)
draw: It ended level, so nobody wins.

tutorial.info: Half-suit ownership and the winning condition appear here. Five takes the game.
tutorial.players: Each seat's team and card count. Even a teammate's hand is hidden.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. You may only ask for a card from a half-suit you hold, and only one you do not hold yourself.
tutorial.actions: You may ask opponents only. A claim places all six cards, and misnaming a teammate cancels it.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.
